description: This file implements background reflection triggered by negative user feedback in a Teams environment. It handles building reflection prompts, dispatching responses, recording learnings, and optionally sending follow-up messages, integrating with various modules for runtime, messaging, and session management.

methods.name: buildFeedbackEvent
methods.description: Constructs a feedback event object with provided parameters, including timestamp and feedback value.

methods.name: buildReflectionContext
methods.description: Builds the context payload for sending a reflection prompt to Teams, including envelope formatting.

methods.name: createReflectionCaptureDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a dispatcher to handle sending reflection responses and capturing the reply.

methods.name: sendReflectionFollowUp
methods.description: Sends a follow-up message to the user in Teams, based on the reflection response.

methods.name: runFeedbackReflection
methods.description: Main function to run background reflection after negative feedback, dispatching prompts, processing responses, storing learnings, and optionally sending follow-up messages.
